exposure: spontaneous vaginal birth with episiotomy or sutured perineal tear
vaginal birth with minimal or no perineal trauma
outcome: time to resumption of vaginal sex
finding: Women were more likely to resume sex later than 8 weeks after their second birth if they had a spontaneous vaginal birth with episiotomy or sutured perineal tear, operative vaginal birth or cesarean delivery compared with a vaginal birth with minimal or no perineal trauma.
mod_finding: Women who had a cesarean delivery were more likely to resume sex later than 8 weeks after their second birth compared with women who had a vaginal birth with minimal or no perineal trauma.
